title: 2024年春节期间上海市科技政务服务中心受理窗口对外接待服务时间调整通知
issuer: 上海市科技政务服务中心
text:
2024年春节期间上海市科技政务服务中心受理窗口对外接待服务时间调整通知
发布日期：2024-01-29
根据《国务院办公厅关于2024年部分节假日安排的通知》（国办发明电〔2023〕7号）规定，上海市科技政务服务中心（徐汇区中山西路1525号技贸大厦一楼）2024年春节期间2月10日至17日不对外接待，共8天。2月4日(星期日)、2月18日(星期日)正常对外接待。
服务时间：
中山西路1525号受理点
每周一至周五
09:00-16:30（最晚取号时间16:15）
请广大申请人合理安排时间，并提前通过“一网通办”总门户、随申办APP等渠道进行线上预约。
恭贺大家在新的一年，工作顺利、身体健康、阖家幸福！
上海市科学技术委员会
2024年1月29日
Notice on Window Reception Hours of Shanghai Science & Technology Administrative Service Center during the 2024 Spring Festival Holiday
In accordance with the Notice of the General Office of the State Council on the Arrangement of Some Holidays in 2024 (General Office of the SCPRC [2023] 7), the reception windows (specifically at 1F Jimao Building, 1525 West Zhongshan Road, Xuhui District) for handling Foreigner’s Work Permit in Shanghai will be closed during the Spring Festival holiday, specifically from February 10 to 17, 2024, and will be open on February 4 (Sunday) and February 18 (Sunday).
Business Hour:
1525 West Zhongshan Road
Monday to Friday
09:00-16:30 (Number taking time: before 16:15)
Shanghai Science & Technology Administrative Service Center provides both by-appointment and walk-in services, and the customers who have made an online appointment, through Government Online-Offline Shanghai, Suishenban or the like, will get priority if they come to the Service Center as scheduled. Thank you for your attention and cooperation.
Best wishes for the holiday and happiness throughout the new year.
Science and Technology Commission of Shanghai Municipality
January 29, 2024
